hypothesis: Conditional fear deployment and qualified greed trimming improve after-cost compounding versus an identical stock selector without compromising the MDD constraint.

design.walk_forward: 5y initial training, 1y validation, next 1y test; expanding forward; exact cutoffs registered after G0 coverage check, before inspecting returns
design.embargo: No overlapping forward labels across splits; embargo up to 252 sessions where the longest outcome is used for tuning.
design.unseen_oos: Respect the existing accepted historical holdout and multiple-testing registry; never call an already inspected interval unseen.
design.multiple_testing: Record all nine sensitivity trials and all control/failed arms; select a plateau, not the best point.

data_requirements: point-in-time universe with delistings and corporate actions
release-time macro vintages and availability-lagged positioning
independent sentiment-family mapping and within-family redundancy audit
issuer thesis/valuation/revisions captured only when public
market-specific US/KR calendar and FX translation
execution_contract: Freeze selector and rebalance clock across arms; no reselection advantage for the overlay
Honor the accepted next-session execution rule, gaps, spread, impact, turnover, taxes, suspensions and partial fills
Residual cash earns actual point-in-time reserve carry net of fees; separately report zero-yield sensitivity
Never overlay weights on an already exposure-adjusted return series (double scaling)
Use own total-return equity/NAV path for each arm, not reset wealth at fear events

acceptance.condition: Compare risk-matched baseline with block-bootstrap uncertainty; reject if advantage disappears after costs or is isolated to one crisis. Goals are not guarantees. Independent review and shadow approval required.

current_blockers: no verified current or historical raw-input adapters in this package
no complete repo checkout for protected Tier-1 test registration
not wired to any official target or monitoring writer
